messages:
omar: FYI ACME did an emergency replay that overlapped our daily window; ledger showing small negative adjustments for some customers. Can someone triage?

katie: Do we have sample payloads? My hunch: retries created new event_ids so our dedupe missed them.

acme-ing-engineer: Sorry  we retried after 429s and re-posted ~900 events with fresh uuids. sample:
```json
{"customer_id":"cust-900","usage":250,"timestamp":"2026-07-08T03:00:00Z","event_id":"evt-zz99"}
```

claire: Reconcile show same entitlement fingerprint but different event_ids. ~8 accounts hit, total over-credit ~3,100 units.

sam: Support flagged one customer paused on our side. Need a short note + ETA for fixes.

omar: Plan: (1) billing ops exception for manual reconcile, (2) short-term ingest guard: reject replays without X-Replay-Id header (return 422), (3) update partner runbook. @billing-ops-bot create-ticket please.

billing-ops-bot: Created EX-2026-912 assigned to @claire. SLA 48h.

claire: I'll take EX-2026-912. Need CSV from partner mapping original_event_id -> replay_event_id. Will run dry-run then apply reversals with audit ids.

katie: I'll push a small guard that rejects replay uploads missing X-Replay-Id and adds an alert for replay spikes. ETA ~2h.

sam: Drafting the customer blurb now; will post in #support-drafts in 20m.

acme-ing-engineer: Sending CSV and disabling the backfill. We'll update client to preserve event_ids and include X-Replay-Id on replays. Apologies.

claire: Dry-run done. 8 accounts, total 3,100 units. Applying manual reversals and attaching audit IDs to EX-2026-912. Keeping ticket open 48h for verification.

omar: Thanks all. Follow-up 30m sync with ACME PM to agree replay contract and test vectors. Closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
